gloss: with a hidden story; (of goods) sold cheap for flaws

definitions.gloss: with a hidden story; having special circumstances
definitions.explanation: Of a person, couple or situation: with some reason or circumstances behind it that are not openly told.
Of goods: sold at a discount because of a flaw, usually cosmetic, such as an odd shape, broken pieces or damaged packaging. Often written {訳|わけ}アリ.

examples.japanese: {訳|わけ}あり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧だ。
examples.english: There seems to be something behind it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧{訳|わけ}あり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She had a look that said there was more to the story.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}して→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧きた⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{訳|わけ}ありらしい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧うわさになった。
examples.english: Rumors spread in the neighborhood that the family who had suddenly moved from the city had some hidden story.

examples.japanese: {訳|わけ}あり⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: To buy goods sold cheap because of flaws.

examples.japanese: {訳|わけ}あり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The discounted apples are oddly shaped, but they taste the same.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「{訳|わけ}アリ」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}かれた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{買|か}ったら→買う：00489_kau⟧、⟦{割|わ}れている→割れる：00907_wareru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧よかった。
examples.english: I bought some snacks marked "flawed" cheaply online; they were just broken and tasted fine.

notes:
⟦{訳|わけ}→訳：01095_wake⟧ (reason, circumstances) + あり (there is). Also written {訳|わけ}アリ or わけあり, especially on shop signs and online stores.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {訳|わけ}あり⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: goods sold cheap because of flaws
- {訳|わけ}あり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧: a property with a problem, often one where something bad happened
- {訳|わけ}あり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧: a couple with a complicated story
